goal: Prevent signed integer overflow in relative ban time calculations
Avoid extreme relative ban durations being treated as expired and silently dropped while reporting success
agreement: Support after author switched to rejecting extreme durations instead of using saturating addition (maflcko)
Agreed that clamping or rejecting values larger than meaningful use cases is appropriate (maflcko)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it fixes an integer overflow where extreme relative durations silently fail
Prevents a UBSan runtime error and ensures setban rejects invalid ban times instead of reporting success
